purpose: Teach: はがき/盛大/綱/分厚い/先人/新郎/新婦/狐

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いとこから、絵はがき、届いた!
lines.en: A postcard from my cousin just arrived!
lines.style: Quick, genuine delight on the opening. Bright and present — the kind of excitement that doesn't perform. Clean attack on the announcement, like she's pulled out the card to show.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。文化祭、盛大に開催されるよね。
lines.en: Yeah. The cultural festival's going to be huge this year.
lines.style: Engaged, nodding along. Light warmth in the agreement. Pace picks up slightly on 「盛大に」— following her energy. Conversational, not distant.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 運動会、綱引き、毎年、楽しいんだよ。
lines.en: Sports day's always fun — especially the tug-of-war. That's the best part.
lines.style: Lighting up as she remembers. Words tumble with genuine enthusiasm, not performed brightness. Slight lean-in energy, inviting him into the memory.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 参考書、分厚いから、リュック重い。
lines.en: My backpack's killing me. These reference books are so thick.
lines.style: Wry half-laugh underneath. The complaint is real but half-joking. Slight eye-roll in the vocal delivery. Matter-of-fact, tired but not defeated.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 歴史で、先人の業績、習った。
lines.en: We learned about some amazing historical figures in class recently.
lines.style: More thoughtful now, voice settling. Genuine interest — not performing seriousness. Slight pause before continuing, like she's still turning something over in her mind.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いとこの兄、もうすぐ新郎になる。
lines.en: My cousin's brother's getting married soon, actually.
lines.style: Casual delivery, almost offhand. Not trying to impress with the news. Warm but measured — observing his reaction more than announcing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 新婦は、地元の小学校の先生らしい。
lines.en: The bride's a teacher at the local elementary school.
lines.style: Bright uptick again. Sharing a detail she thinks is nice. Slight smile in her voice — she approves. Not gossiping, just connecting dots.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 神社で、狐の像、いっぱい飾られてた。
lines.en: There were so many fox statues all around the shrine when I visited.
lines.style: Curious, noticing tone. Quiet observation — she's genuinely struck by the detail. Slight trailing-off at the end, like she's still picturing it. Wondering what he'll think.
